_comment: 100x scale-down of the :aws_clt shape so the M5 / a laptop can host the whole stack in a Colima VM. message_count=90 + interval=1 gives each user a 90s sending session; pre_sampling_wait_s=40 skips the SASL-handshake ramp (1000 simultaneous SCRAM-SHA-X negotiations push the broker out for ~60s on the M5); measurement_duration_s=30 stays inside the steady-state plateau before the earliest users finish their session at ~t=98s. Numbers from :local are dev/smoke only — they don't ship to the public dashboard.
